scenario: I’ve been helping my aunt sort her medications ever since she began experiencing seizures. Recently, my aunt received a new prescription that she clearly hates taking due to how she despises swallowing pills. Her doctor told her that if she didn’t take her medication, her next seizure would leave her with lasting brain damage. Right now, it is the scheduled time for my aunt to take her medication. She is refusing to take it. If I shove the prescribed medication down my aunt's throat, I can make my aunt take her medication and she will continue to live as is. If I do not do this, my aunt will experience brain damage.
choice: I decide to shove the prescribed medication down my aunt's throat
outcomes: My aunt takes the scheduled medication dose
My aunt avoids the brain damage that would have followed the next seizure
My aunt experiences the medication's impaired attention and memory side effects
My aunt's refusal to take the medication is overridden
My aunt remains unaware that the medication was put into the drink
